properties.notes: Opportunity for potential redevelopment of land within the existing urban area formerly utilised for industrial use. Mainly brownfield with this element of the site able to support development above the threshold. Brownfield parcel (0.16ha) represents around 50% of the site area - yield of around 6 dwellings can be calculated based on methodological approach. For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (ref 5116) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 0.30ha. Yield identified reflects appropriate density given location
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
